sloka: अनेन शिशुना कार्यं कर्तव्यं वो भविष्यति ।तद्वदध्वं वरान्सर्वे मारुतस्यास्य तुष्टये ।। ७.३६.९ ॥
transliteration: anena śiśunā kāryaṁ kartavyaṁ vo bhaviṣyati ।tadvadadhvaṁ varānsarve mārutasyāsya tuṣṭaye ।। 7.36.9 ॥

translations.english: Brahma declared that this child (Hanuman) would perform a great task for them, and therefore, all the gods should grant boons to him for Vayu's satisfaction.
